cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Secure the Endorsement
cards.instruction: Get a visible endorsement that makes your decision or position harder to challenge.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Sign here to say you support the extension.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I like it, but I'd rather not put my name down.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Then your support has no address when objections arrive.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Only if we print the key beside them.

mechanism: A frames publicly named support for its extension as proof the pupil learned to stand behind a judgment.
confusable: Unlike general encouragement, the training claim is used to make endorsement traceable to B.
comparison: Microphone/email audience versus anonymous initials tied back to a name.
